title: Programming tasks with history-based AI feedback
summary: First-semester programming students choose a Processing task and solve it in an intelligent tutoring system. They can compare GPT-4o feedback based on their current code with feedback based on their full code history, select the more useful response, and rate it.

sources.title: The Power of Context: An LLM-based Programming Tutor with Focused and Proactive Feedback
sources.evidence_quote: Participants then selected one of three programming tasks, each addressing different requirements.

course.name: Fundamentals of Programming
course.institution: Technical University of Applied Sciences Augsburg

assessment.summary: Solve a prime-number, graphical-pattern, or Fibonacci task in Processing while requesting and comparing two forms of AI feedback.
student_actions: Choose one of three programming tasks.
Compare history-based and current-state feedback and select the preferred version.

student_role.description: GPT-4o gives code-free guidance based on either the current submission or the student's execution history.
